note: Endpoints intentionally NOT composing authMiddleware. Each entry records the exported symbol, the repo-relative file path, and the authorization mechanism applied instead. Consumed by scripts/enumerate-server-functions.mjs and the Test_Suite (spec admin-quality-gates-and-shared-contracts, Requirements 6.1-6.2). An entry whose symbol/path the enumeration does not find is stale and fails the Test_Suite. Every createServerFn declaration under src/ composes authMiddleware and therefore appears nowhere in this file.

entries.mechanism: shared-secret header gate: returns 503 when OPS_CRON_SECRET is unset and 401 unless cronSecretMatches(request.headers.get("authorization")) does a constant-time compare of the Bearer value against OPS_CRON_SECRET (src/lib/admin/daily-drafts.server.ts:280).
entries.reason: Unattended GitHub Actions cron caller has no Firebase ID token, so the admin-claim/allowlist boundary cannot apply. Writes daily_pack_drafts only; skip reasons are mapped through publicSkipReason so no internal error text leaks.

entries.mechanism: public by design: no authorization. Returns only publishable Firebase web config values (FIREBASE_WEB_API_KEY, derived authDomain, projectId) with Cache-Control: private, max-age=300; the service account never leaves the server.
entries.reason: The sign-in form needs this config before any token exists — a server function would run the auth middleware, which itself depends on this config to mint a token, so gating it would deadlock login.
